questions.explanation: Tranquil means calm and peaceful, free from disturbance.
questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to TRANQUIL.

questions.explanation: Brave means showing courage, so its opposite is cowardly.
questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to BRAVE.

questions.explanation: The verb apologized is followed by the preposition for when giving the reason.
questions.q: Fill in the blank: He apologized ___ being late.

questions.explanation: Each of takes a singular verb, so have completed should be has completed; the error is in part B.
questions.q: Identify the part with an error: Each of the students (A) have completed (B) their assignment (C) on time. No error (D)

questions.explanation: To let the cat out of the bag means to reveal a secret, often by accident.
questions.q: What does the idiom TO LET THE CAT OUT OF THE BAG mean?

questions.explanation: Expand means to become larger, so its opposite is contract, meaning to become smaller.
questions.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to EXPAND.

questions.explanation: Specific clock times take the preposition at, as in at 7 o'clock.
questions.q: Fill in the blank: The train leaves ___ 7 o'clock in the morning.

questions.explanation: Vivid means bright, clear and full of life in description or colour.
questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to VIVID.

questions.explanation: Once in a blue moon describes something that happens very rarely.
questions.q: What does the idiom ONCE IN A BLUE MOON mean?

questions.explanation: The correct preposition after married is to.
questions.q: Fill in the blank: She is married ___ a doctor.
